title: Glessner's granite courses and front door set to the survey
items: Glessner's granite courses now start where the 1963 survey drawings start them, about two inches higher along Prairie Avenue. Running the courses level round the corner shows the 18th Street ground stands that much above the Prairie Avenue walk.
The front door is three inches shorter, 7.5 feet, so its top sits on a course line as both survey drawings and the 1888 photograph show it. The stone above it comes down to meet it.
